summary: Katherine Clark has represented Massachusetts's 5th district in the House since 2013 and has been the House Democratic whip, the party's second-ranking leader, since 2023, after serving as caucus vice chair and assistant speaker under Nancy Pelosi. After Democrats won the House majority in November 2026 she was designated to become majority leader in January 2027.
